craft_notes: Sthāyin: gathered lotus (vicinuta = PICK! imperative of transmission). Sanskrit-first: apagatasaṃkocam (whose CONTRACTION IS GONE — uncontracted, kept) + maheśapūjanahetoḥ (for Maheśa-WORSHIP's sake — purpose-compound). Abhinavagupta frame: grace arrives as feet-fall light (pāta as touch, not argument); the disciple's only act is gathering. Rows: 1 (imperative gathered late — ‘gather it’ before the purpose-phrase), 2 (purpose-compound unpacked after colon — suspension then gathering; mirror-pause vs L3's dash). Close: ‘worship’ (pūjana end-weighted — purpose as destination). Rejected: ‘collect’ for gather — killed: vicinuta picks (flowers); fronting ‘for worship’ — killed: hetu lands last. Read aloud: HEART-lo-tus … un-con-TRACT-ed — BY śam-bhu-NĀ-tha SUN's FEET-fall LIGHT: GA-ther it for ma-HE-śa-WOR-ship.

lines: by Śambhunātha Sun's feet-fall light: gather it for Maheśa-worship.

reads_against.argmap: By what grace, and to what end? → Lineage-feet uncontract the heart; the gathered lotus serves worship.
c1_essence: Mother of stainless art and new creation, five-faced Father hidden in splendor: may their yamal-burst Heart, deathless kin beyond all, flash forth; the unplungeable ocean condensed to plain essence — hear it; the heart-lotus uncontracted by the master's feet gathered for worship.
reads_against.c1_rasa: adbhuta-śānta of invocation settling into teaching
